notes.title: Update v 0.5.0
notes.content:
[h1]New features:[/h1] 
[list]
[*] Updated models of obstacles: pipes, colorizers, portals that source of balls. 
[*] Replaced the colors of the balls with brighter. 
[*] Added patterns on the balls. 
[*] Changed effects for balls from which bonuses appear. 
[*] Now you can skip the animation at the beginning of the level. 
[*] In the level selection menu, you can scroll controllers. 
[*] Balls at the start of the level come out faster. 
[*] Adjusted balance at some levels. 
[/list]

[h1]Bugs fixed:[/h1] 
[list]
[*] Fix the line for the balls that were not visible underwater. 
[*] Fix an issue that makes it not possible to completely turn off the sound. 
[*] Fix issue then sometimes progress was not saved between game sessions. 
[*] Game stay on pause when calling the steam menu. 
[*] Fixed the case when at the start of the level sometimes there is no laser in one of the pistols. 
[/list]

notes.title: v 0.4.1 - bug fixes & improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Changed level star counting system.
[*] Pause is no longer blocked during the level opening animation.
[*] Improved visibility of different laser colors.
[*] Introduced smoother transition to uneasy music.
[*] Bugfix: game freezes after losing a level.
[*] Bugfix: balls are not always destroyed after successful shots.
[/list]

notes.title: v 0.4.0
notes.content:
Removed selection of difficulty level but added 20 more levels to each chapter.
Redesigned levels in all chapters and changed the balance.
Localized interface for 16 languages.
Moved saves to Steam, to the cloud storage.
Numerous minor fixes.

notes.title: v 0.3.4
notes.content:
[b]Update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new Chapter (Shadow Valley)
[*] Redesigned main menu UI
[*] Added highlighting of the line where the balls are dangerously close to the snapdragon
[*] If both your guns are loaded with balls of the same color, now you can shoot them towards single balls in the line to make three-ball combos
[*] Fully updated bonus levels for Epic and Legendary difficulties in all chapters: now bonus levels are entirely different for every difficulty level.
[*] New spawn points in the first Chapter for new bonus levels 
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved game optimization, improved multithreading, enabling you to play in VR mode even on a laptop
[*] Changed level architecture for loading new chapters via DLC
[*] Increased number of light sources for all levels and effects
[*] Improved light source processing
[*] Changed PostProcessing and color correction
[*] Reduced size of treasure chests
[*] The game migrated to the new Unity version
[*] Updated to the latest renderer version
[*] Updated spline processing
[*] Updated selected sound effects
[*] Changed difficulty balance for selected levels
[*] Minor VFX improvements
[*] 
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the water Shader in Chapter 2 to correctly display glow from treasure chests and other effects with the water background
[*] Fixed UI elements and text sorting problems: everything is displayed in the correct order and UI does not show through the 3D model
[*] Fixed displaying stars upon level completion
[*] Now the Paint bomb bonus is also yellow
[*] Fixed display of yellow soul effects
[*] Fixed freezing of the ball magnetization effect
[*] Fixed spatial sound effects
[*] Minor bug fixes
[*] 
[/list]
[b]Please be careful: [/b]
[list]
[*] This update resets your current progress statistics in the game. 
[*] The second Chapter will become additional content.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v 0.2.0
notes.content:
In brief: yes, we're working on new chapters)
[h2]New features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Chests[/b]. For now, additional points and bonus level keys can be found in chests. Each level has only one key. You have 20-25% chance to get the key from the chest.
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/779621670737468388/741F1F81AE15C53B87B80434A1EB2294301A837D/[/img]
[*] [b]Bonus levels[/b] (can be opened by keys from chests). The bonus levels are an experiment, so please tell us what you think about it and what you expect from this feature.
[*] [b]Various difficulties[/b]. Epic and Legendary difficulty levels add one extra color to the lines and increase the total amount of balls in the level and the line speed. New difficulty opens when you collect all stars in current difficulty.
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/779621670737395932/955EF5E539D74683F72026108017447FDE7F14BF/[/img]
[*] [b]NO VR mode[/b]. You can select this mode when starting the game from Steam. Please test this feature and post your feedback, we really need it!
[/list]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated main menu UI, so you can see your chapter progress on “chapter select” tab, all requirements and progress on buttons.
[*] Redesigned levels 1-4, 1-7, 1-9 
[*] Changed balance in Chapter 1 and 2 levels
[*] Now every chapter is unlocked by default so you can start playing from any chapter you want.
[/list]
	
[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed blurry image effect caused by second anti aliasing - the images are sharp and clear now
[*] Improved lighting on guns in the main scene
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/779621670737389609/72A99452F4255A52C45B29236989C5163AEBF93E/[/img]
[*] Game effects optimization, so the game runs more smoothly
[*] Fixed some bugs with magnet effect and balls collisions
[*] And don’t forget - that's is not the final product, and if you like or don’t like something - please tell us
[/list]

notes.title: Patch - v0.1.1
notes.content:
Patch - v0.1.1.
Mostly made improvements based on community feedback

[list]
[*] balance changed in 1-4, 1-6, 1-7, 2-7 and 1-10 levels
[*] level 1-4 and 1-8 switched
[*] bonuses now hiding in "bubble" balls on line - just pop this ball as usual and you'll get bonus
[*] stars mechanic balanced and made easier to understand (it's just based on score)
[*]  line appearing mechanic balance changed
[*] "scary music" now works better - no more 10 mins with 2 kinds of music plays at the same time
[*]  autorecenter now calls only at start game and first-level load
[*]  no more appearing bonuses at final lines
[*]  appearing bonus sorting fix (no more gold balls that appear one by one)
[*]  now you can call pause menu in-game with ESC button too
[*]  game UI don't follow player view anymore
[*]  pistols now reset its balls on "level end" screen
[*] water in chapter 2 now more dark
[*] Gold ball - actually it is Rainbow ball) so we changed its texture - enjoy :wink:
[*] some bug fixes
[*] some minor improvements
[/list]
